## Pre-registered points that could not be built (replaced by their fallback)

- **P2-R3 67% physically sized** (`w2_p2r3.json`): base not routable: global routing congested (GRT-0116; met1/met2/met3 overflow 24/1/12) after the flow grew the cell utilization from 67% to 83% (sizing + P2 timing repair); pre-registered fallback: 60%
- **P2-R2 67% physically sized** (`w2_p2r2.json`): base not routable: global routing congestion too high (GRT-0232, during antenna repair) after sizing; pre-registered fallback: 60%
